quote:
I dont have a problem with the fact that I have the option to play regular citizen simulator, I have a problem with all of the freedom restrictions that rob me of what makes gta... well... gta. It essentially makes this a scam because this just isnt a gta game anymore. Besides if I wanted to do half the mundane content in the game, I would just go outside and live my life.
Also fyi shoving your political agenda down your consumers throats without giving them a choice is an EXTREMELY poor buisness practice and the fastest way to kill your source of revenue, look at how it turned out for halo studios.
